next.reason: 1985: "The INVALID KEY phrase or the AT END phrase must be specified if no applicable USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure is specified"; 2023: "No READ syntax rule requires either phrase; GR-9.1.14-4: "not specified ... and there are no applicable exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end"". 2023 READ syntax rules drop the requirement. A READ with neither phrase and no USE procedure is now valid, and control goes to the end of the statement (9.1.14-4, 14.9.30.4-24 d).
